title: phegopteris poeppigii
intro: Phegopteris poeppigii, commonly known as the Chilean water fern or water fern, is a species of fern native to South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Phegopteris poeppigii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its health benefits.
